title: Zinc Content in Yeast Cytosol and Media Composition
summary: This cluster is about the zinc content in yeast cytosol and the composition of media used to grow yeast cells. The cytosol of various yeast cells, including mutant cells and cells with specific deletions, contains zinc from compounds like CM100 and CM104. The cytosol also contains various chemicals, including DTT, HPW, PMSF, and sorbitol. Media used to grow yeast cells contains Zn(acetate)2, which is a source of zinc. The composition of ABC buffer is also described, including its components HPW, ammonium bicarbonate, and sorbitol.
